activities.name: Dongdaemun Design Plaza
activities.description: A major urban landmark in Seoul with a neo-futuristic design, featuring exhibition spaces, a design museum, and rolling rooftop parks.

activities.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
activities.description: The largest of the Five Grand Palaces built during the Joseon Dynasty, featuring expansive throne halls, pavilions, and royal museums.

activities.name: N Seoul Tower
activities.description: Communication and observation tower located on Namsan Mountain, offering panoramic views of the entire Seoul metropolitan area.

activities.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
activities.description: A traditional residential neighborhood in Seoul boasting hundreds of hanok traditional houses dating back to the Joseon Dynasty.

activities.name: Lotte World
activities.description: A major recreation complex in Seoul containing the world's largest indoor theme park, an outdoor amusement park, an artificial island, and luxury hotels.

activities.name: Changdeokgung Palace Secret Garden
activities.description: A rear garden of Changdeokgung Palace featuring natural wooded areas, lotus ponds, and pavilions built for the royal family.

activities.name: National Museum of Korea
activities.description: The flagship museum of Korean history and art in South Korea, housing a vast collection of cultural properties and historical artifacts.

activities.name: Bukhansan National Park
activities.description: A mountainous national park on the northern fringes of Seoul, popular for hiking, granite peaks, and historical mountain fortresses.

activities.name: Leeum Museum of Art
activities.description: A museum showcasing traditional Korean art alongside contemporary international works, housed in architecturally distinct buildings.

activities.name: Seoul Folk Flea Market
activities.description: A massive flea market featuring vintage items, antiques, secondhand goods, and traditional crafts from various eras.

activities.name: Garosu-gil Street Styling Tour
activities.description: A guided walking tour focusing on the trendy fashion boutiques, designer flagships, and street style culture of Sinsa-dong.

activities.name: K-Beauty Makeover Experience
activities.description: A professional styling and makeup session inspired by current Korean celebrity trends and skincare routines.

activities.name: Seoul Style Museum Exhibition
activities.description: An exhibition space dedicated to the evolution of Korean clothing, modern fashion design, and textile arts.

activities.name: Dongdaemun Fashion District Walking Tour
activities.description: An introductory tour of South Korea's largest wholesale and retail fashion hub, exploring manufacturing history and design markets.

activities.name: Styling & Personal Shopper Workshop
activities.description: An interactive workshop led by local stylists teaching Korean fashion aesthetics, wardrobe curation, and trend forecasting.

food.name: Tosokhon Samgyetang
food.description: A renowned traditional restaurant famous for serving samgyetang, a nourishing ginseng chicken soup stuffed with glutinous rice and jujubes.

food.name: Gwangjang Market Food Alley
food.description: A bustling traditional street food market offering local delicacies such as bindaetteok mung bean pancakes and mayak gimbap.

food.name: Myeongdong Kyoja
food.description: An iconic local eatery specializing in hand-made knife-cut noodles in a rich chicken broth and steamed dumplings.

food.name: Maple Tree House
food.description: A popular Korean barbecue restaurant serving high-grade hanwoo beef and pork belly grilled at the table.

food.name: Tongin Market
food.description: A traditional market where visitors can use brass coins to fill a lunchbox with various small side dishes and street food items from different vendors.

food.name: Hadongkwan
food.description: A long-standing institution famous for gomtang, a clear and hearty beef bone soup served with rice.

food.name: Noryangjin Fisheries Wholesale Market
food.description: A massive wholesale seafood market where visitors can buy fresh catch and have it prepared immediately at nearby restaurants.

food.name: Balwoo Gongyang
food.description: A Michelin-starred restaurant run by the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, serving authentic temple cuisine free of pungent herbs and animal products.

food.name: Seoul Animation Center Cafe
food.description: A themed cafe located in the animation district offering specialty coffee, character desserts, and creative beverages.

food.name: Tosokchon Korean BBQ House
food.description: A traditional eatery specializing in marinated galbi and locally sourced pork cuts served with authentic banchan side dishes.

food.name: Insa-dong Traditional Teahouse
food.description: A quiet heritage teahouse serving traditional Korean herbal teas, flower teas, and handmade rice cakes.

food.name: Gwangjang Market Dak Hanmari Alley
food.description: A local favorite spot specializing in whole chicken soup boiled with garlic, potatoes, and rice cakes, paired with spicy dipping sauce.

food.name: Mangwon Market Street Food Stalls
food.description: A vibrant neighborhood market offering a wide range of local street snacks, handmade croquettes, and fried chicken.

food.name: Namdaemun Kalguksu Alley
food.description: A historic alley inside Namdaemun Market where vendors serve steaming bowls of handmade knife-cut noodles and barley rice.
